verses.original: Καὶ τοῦ σαββάτου διαγενομένου Μαρία ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Μαρία ἡ τοῦ Ἰακώβου καὶ Σαλώμη ἠγόρασαν ἀρώματα ἵνα ἐλθοῦσαι ἀλείψωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Kai tou sabbatou diagenomenou Maria hē Magdalēnē kai Maria hē tou Iakōbou kai Salōmē ēgorasan arōmata hina elthousai aleipsōsin auton
verses.literal: When the Sabbath was over Mary - Magdalene - Mary the [mother] - of James and Salome bought spices so they could go [and] anoint [the body of Jesus]

verses.original: καὶ λίαν πρωῒ τῇ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων τοῦ ἡλίου ἀνατείλαντος ἔρχονται ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον
verses.transliteration: kai lian prōi tē mia tōn sabbatōn tou hēliou anateilantos erchontai epi to mnēmeion
verses.literal: - Very early on the first [day] of the week - just after sunrise . . . they went to the tomb

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἑαυτάς Τίς ἀποκυλίσει τὸν λίθον ἡμῖν ἐκ τῆς θύρας τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: kai elegon pros heautas Tis apokylisei ton lithon hēmin ek tēs thyras tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: - They were asking - one another Who will roll away the stone - from the entrance of the tomb

verses.original: καὶ ἀναβλέψασαι θεωροῦσιν ὅτι ὁ λίθος ἀποκεκύλισται γὰρ ἦν σφόδρα μέγας
verses.transliteration: kai anablepsasai theōrousin hoti ho lithos apokekylistai gar ēn sphodra megas
verses.literal: But when they looked up they saw that the stone had been rolled away even though it was extremely large

verses.original: Καὶ εἰσελθοῦσαι εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον εἶδον νεανίσκον περιβεβλημένον λευκήν στολὴν καθήμενον ἐν τοῖς δεξιοῖς καὶ ἐξεθαμβήθησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai eiselthousai eis to mnēmeion eidon neaniskon peribeblēmenon leukēn stolēn kathēmenon en tois dexiois kai exethambēthēsan
verses.literal: When they entered . . . the tomb they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side and they were alarmed

verses.original: δὲ ὁ λέγει αὐταῖς Μὴ ἐκθαμβεῖσθε ζητεῖτε Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζαρηνὸν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον ἠγέρθη ἔστιν οὐκ ὧδε ἴδε ὁ τόπος ὅπου ἔθηκαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de ho legei autais Mē ekthambeisthe zēteite Iēsoun ton Nazarēnon ton estaurōmenon ēgerthē estin ouk hōde ide ho topos hopou ethēkan auton
verses.literal: But - he said to them {Do} not be alarmed You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene who was crucified He has risen He is not here See the place where they put Him

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὑπάγετε εἴπατε αὐτοῦ τοῖς μαθηταῖς καὶ τῷ Πέτρῳ ὅτι Προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἐκεῖ ὄψεσθε αὐτὸν καθὼς εἶπεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: alla hypagete eipate autou tois mathētais kai tō Petrō hoti Proagei hymas eis tēn Galilaian ekei opsesthe auton kathōs eipen hymin
verses.literal: But go tell His - disciples and - Peter - He is going ahead of you into - Galilee There you will see Him just as He told you

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθοῦσαι ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου ἔφυγον γὰρ εἶχεν τρόμος αὐτὰς καὶ ἔκστασις καὶ γάρ ἐφοβοῦντο εἶπαν οὐδὲν οὐδενὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthousai apo tou mnēmeiou ephygon gar eichen tromos autas kai ekstasis kai gar ephobounto eipan ouden oudeni
verses.literal: So [the women] left . . . the tomb and ran away - vvv trembling - and bewildered And vvv in their fear they did not say . . . [a word to anyone]

verses.original: πρωῒ πρώτῃ σαββάτου δὲ Ἀναστὰς ἐφάνη πρῶτον Μαρίᾳ τῇ Μαγδαληνῇ παρ’ ἧς ἐκβεβλήκει ἑπτὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: prōi prōtē sabbatou de Anastas ephanē prōton Maria tē Magdalēnē par’ hēs ekbeblēkei hepta daimonia
verses.literal: Early [on the] first [day] of the week - after [Jesus] had risen He appeared first to Mary - Magdalene from whom He had driven out seven demons

verses.original: ἐκείνη πορευθεῖσα ἀπήγγειλεν τοῖς γενομένοις μετ’ αὐτοῦ πενθοῦσι καὶ κλαίουσιν
verses.transliteration: ekeinē poreutheisa apēngeilen tois genomenois met’ autou penthousi kai klaiousin
verses.literal: She went [and] told those who had been with Him who were mourning and weeping

verses.original: κἀκεῖνοι ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ζῇ καὶ ἐθεάθη ὑπ’ αὐτῆς ἠπίστησαν
verses.transliteration: kakeinoi akousantes hoti zē kai etheathē hyp’ autēs ēpistēsan
verses.literal: And when they heard that [Jesus] was alive and she had seen Him . . . . . . they did not believe [it]

verses.original: δὲ Μετὰ ταῦτα ἐφανερώθη ἐν ἑτέρᾳ μορφῇ δυσὶν ἐξ αὐτῶν περιπατοῦσιν πορευομένοις εἰς ἀγρόν
verses.transliteration: de Meta tauta ephanerōthē en hetera morphē dysin ex autōn peripatousin poreuomenois eis agron
verses.literal: - After [this] [Jesus] appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in [the] country

verses.original: κἀκεῖνοι ἀπελθόντες ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς λοιποῖς ἐπίστευσαν ἐκείνοις οὐδὲ
verses.transliteration: kakeinoi apelthontes apēngeilan tois loipois episteusan ekeinois oude
verses.literal: And they went back and reported [it] to the rest but they did not believe them either

verses.original: δὲ Ὕστερον αὐτοῖς ἀνακειμένοις ἐφανερώθη τοῖς ἕνδεκα καὶ ὠνείδισεν αὐτῶν τὴν ἀπιστίαν καὶ σκληροκαρδίαν ὅτι οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν τοῖς θεασαμένοις αὐτὸν ἐγηγερμένον
verses.transliteration: de Hysteron autois anakeimenois ephanerōthē tois hendeka kai ōneidisen autōn tēn apistian kai sklērokardian hoti ouk episteusan tois theasamenois auton egēgermenon
verses.literal: - Later as they were eating [Jesus] appeared to the Eleven and rebuked them for their - unbelief and hardness of heart because vvv they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πορευθέντες εἰς ἅπαντα τὸν κόσμον κηρύξατε τὸ εὐαγγέλιον πάσῃ τῇ κτίσει
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Poreuthentes eis hapanta ton kosmon kēryxate to euangelion pasē tē ktisei
verses.literal: And He said to them Go into all the world [and] preach the gospel to every - creature

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύσας καὶ βαπτισθεὶς σωθήσεται δὲ ὁ ἀπιστήσας κατακριθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ho pisteusas kai baptistheis sōthēsetai de ho apistēsas katakrithēsetai
verses.literal: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved but whoever does not believe will be condemned

verses.original: δὲ ταῦτα σημεῖα παρακολουθήσει τοῖς πιστεύσασιν ἐν μου τῷ ὀνόματί ἐκβαλοῦσιν δαιμόνια λαλήσουσιν καιναῖς γλώσσαις
verses.transliteration: de tauta sēmeia parakolouthēsei tois pisteusasin en mou tō onomati ekbalousin daimonia lalēsousin kainais glōssais
verses.literal: And these signs will accompany those who believe In My - name they will drive out demons they will speak in new tongues

verses.original: και ἀροῦσιν ὄφεις ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν κἂν πίωσιν τι θανάσιμόν οὐ μὴ βλάψῃ αὐτοὺς ἐπιθήσουσιν χεῖρας ἐπὶ ἀρρώστους καὶ ἕξουσιν καλῶς
verses.transliteration: kai arousin opheis en tais chersin kan piōsin ti thanasimon ou mē blapsē autous epithēsousin cheiras epi arrōstous kai hexousin kalōs
verses.literal: - they will pick up snakes with their hands and if they drink any deadly poison vvv vvv it will not harm them they will lay [their] hands on [the] sick and they will be made well

verses.original: οὖν μὲν μετὰ τὸ Ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς λαλῆσαι αὐτοῖς ἀνελήμφθη εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐκ δεξιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: oun men meta to Ho Kyrios Iēsous lalēsai autois anelēmphthē eis ton ouranon kai ekathisen ek dexiōn tou Theou
verses.literal: - - After - the Lord Jesus had spoken to them He was taken up into - heaven and sat down at [the] right hand - of God

verses.original: δὲ ἐκεῖνοι ἐξελθόντες ἐκήρυξαν πανταχοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου συνεργοῦντος καὶ βεβαιοῦντος τὸν λόγον διὰ τῶν σημείων ἐπακολουθούντων
verses.transliteration: de ekeinoi exelthontes ekēryxan pantachou tou Kyriou synergountos kai bebaiountos ton logon dia tōn sēmeiōn epakolouthountōn
verses.literal: And they went out [and] preached everywhere [and] the Lord worked through [them] - confirming [His] word by the signs that accompanied [it]
